pairs: Cum invocarem exaudivit me Deus justitiæ meæ,
When I called upon him, the God of my justice heeded me.
In tribulation, you have enlarged me.
Miserere mei, et exaudi orationem meam.
Have mercy on me, and heed my prayer.
Sons of men, how long will you be dull in heart,
so that whatever you love is in vain,
and whatever you seek is false? Pause
Et scitote quoniam mirificavit Dominus sanctum suum;
And know this: the Lord has made wondrous his holy one.
Dominus exaudiet me cum clamavero ad eum.
The Lord will heed me when I cry out to him.
Be angry, and do not be willing to sin.
The things that you say in your hearts:
be sorry for them on your beds. Pause
“Who reveals to us what is good?”
Signatum est super nos lumen vultus tui,
The light of your countenance, Lord,
Domine: dedisti lætitiam in corde meo.
has been sealed upon us. You have given joy to my heart.
By the fruit of their grain,
I will sleep and I will rest.
have established me singularly in hope.
